verdicts.quote: Prefilled schedule: offsets −3, 0, +7, +14 days relative to the due date; send time 09:00 account-local.

A paid, void or draft invoice gets no reminder; reminders stop permanently once outstanding is 0. ... Left out (domain rules): late fees, interest, credit-note handling beyond outstanding balance, disputes (use pause, R-7)
A partial payment leaves it unpaid; the reminder states the outstanding amount.
No customer-facing unsubscribe link in v1; replies go to the business's address. Compliance is an open person-only item (OG-4).
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing customer-level do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed flag suppresses reminders, and whether billing notices are exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: At most once per (invoice, offset), ever. ... a claim for an existing (invoice, offset) record is refused, so concurrent or repeated ticks never both send.
an invoice is a candidate only while it is unpaid (D-4) at the moment of sending (the invoice source is re-read after claim and before handoff, R-5).

Transient provider failure: up to 3 attempts per step, one per tick; a definitive hard failure (invalid address) is not retried. ... settings page shows a count of invoices with a failed or unknown step

provider rate limit: unresolved (OG-8). Constraint without a number: a tick that cannot finish all work leaves the rest claimable by the next tick (AC-11.2), and respects provider rate limits when known.
verdicts.missing: The actual rate limit and how a large batch is paced within it.

verdicts.quote: No backfill. A step is eligible only if its step date is on or after ... the date reminders were last enabled ... Prevents blasting a backlog of overdue customers
step date = due date + offset (calendar days, account zone). ... Left out: business-day calendars, holidays, per-customer time zones.
1234567.80 USD renders unambiguously with the currency code; zero-decimal currency (JPY 5000) renders without decimals.
Billing address empty or syntactically invalid at evaluation: no handoff ... at window end it resolves skipped: no-recipient. ... If the provider later reports a bounce, sent becomes bounced
one email to the invoice's billing address
verdicts.missing: What happens when an invoice or customer has more than one billing contact, and which are written to.

verdicts.quote: each invoice shows its reminder history: per offset, state (sent, failed, unknown, bounced, skipped: <reason>), time, attempts, recipient address used.
Content: business name, customer name, invoice number, outstanding amount with currency, due date, days until/past due, pay link only if the host has one (OG-5)
verdicts.missing: Whether the pay link expires and what happens if it has.

verdicts.quote: Roles: changing settings needs the host's account-admin role; viewing history needs permission to view that invoice; pausing needs permission to edit it.
verdicts.missing: Who may send a reminder by hand (manual sending is not defined at all).

verdicts.quote: Disabling stops new sends immediately for ticks that start after the save
verdicts.missing: Per-customer off switch (only per-invoice pause exists), preview or dry-run, and manual resend.

verdicts.quote: Invoice with reminders on but nothing yet due: empty state reads that the next reminder is scheduled for 2026-12-12
verdicts.missing: A view of upcoming sends beyond an invoice's empty state (e.g. next step after the first send, or account-wide upcoming); failures are covered by R-8.

verdicts.quote: A step (invoice × offset) may be sent on its step date or the one following calendar day (its window). At most one reminder per invoice per calendar day
Reminders never change invoice status, amounts or dates.
